actual_flow: AcquisitionWorldGrowthBridge.admit records a pending attempt under the native overlay lock and requests Data Forge/Epoch admission.

It verifies activation/passport and active owner projection, then uses admitted_membership_delta over before/after epoch members; nonpositive delta returns no growth, positive delta emits a growth receipt.
resume verifies active refs and selects the configured AcquisitionCandidateWorldRefresh by exact tenant/cell/run/route; refresh binds profile_selection_ref, canonical_variable_id, and target_slot_id.

The refresh materializes the uniquely selected source observation into a DataSnapshot and candidate WMR/context, then invokes GenerationCycleController.reenter_after_active_acquisition_overlay on the original case to run the next ordinary cycle/N5 path. It persists an AcquisitionOverlayReentryReceipt and CAS/event refs.

GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id} exists and projects current run details with tenant and temporal controls. The generic normalized-payload test does not assert the new V3 WMR/N5 occurrence is current, history retains both, or response binds to that occurrence.

P38.property: Content change relevant to the same candidate reissues; ID/order/write-time-only change does not.
P38.implementation: Trigger checks positive membership count; refresh materializes the selected row with a fresh transaction_time and builds a new context/WMR. No reviewed comparison to the prior WMR classifies which source fields are semantically relevant.
P38.divergent_case: Same factual value under a newly admitted observation_id can make membership positive and alter the materialized artifact/context bytes. This is a source-level divergent trigger case; whether the native projection remains unique and downstream N5 completes is not established without the exact run/input.
